main.title: 엔비디아 GTC 타이베이 2026: 젠슨 황, N1X·베라 루빈 발표…블랙웰·베라루빈 수주 1조 달러 전망
main.body: 엔비디아 젠슨 황 CEO가 6월 1일 오전 11시(대만 시각) GTC 타이베이 2026 기조연설에서 Arm 노트북칩 N1X와 차세대 AI 플랫폼 베라 루빈을 공식 발표했다. 황 CEO는 블랙웰과 베라 루빈 합산 2025~2027년 누적 수주 예상액을 '최소 1조 달러'로 상향 제시했다고 밝혔다. N1X는 20코어 Arm CPU와 블랙웰 아키텍처 GPU(CUDA 6,144개)를 탑재한 SoC로, 미디어텍과 공동 개발됐다. 엔비디아 파트너스 행사에서는 삼성전자, SK하이닉스, 현대차, LG전자, 두산, 네이버 등 국내 주요 기업 경영진과의 만찬 회동이 예정됐다. 젠슨 황 CEO는 방한 일정도 가져 6월 5일께 서울을 방문할 예정이다.
main.keep_reason: GTC 타이베이 기조연설 한국어 1차 — 베라 루빈 + N1X + Blackwell 누적 수주 1조 달러 전망, 국내 만찬 회동 디테일 추가.
main.select_reason: GTC 타이베이 키노트 한국어 1차 primary로 N1X·베라 루빈·$1T 누적 수주 전망 등 핵심 데이터 포인트 집약 + 한국 기업 만찬 회동 디테일 포함 — 한국 독자에게 keynote+local 두 차원을 모두 전달.

main.title: Samsung Electronics Ships World's First HBM4E 12-High Samples
main.body: Samsung Electronics announced it has begun shipping the industry's first 12-layer HBM4E samples to major global customers. The 12-layer HBM4E supports per-pin speeds of 14 to 16 gigabits per second and delivers up to 3.6 TB/s bandwidth per stack. The 48 GB capacity represents more than 30% increase from the previous generation. The HBM4E includes Samsung's 6th-generation 10-nanometer-class DRAM process (1c) and Samsung Foundry's 4nm logic base die. Advanced low-power design technologies and optimized packaging structures improved energy efficiency by 16% and thermal resistance characteristics by more than 14% compared to the previous generation. The announcement came only three months after Samsung started mass production of HBM4. SK Hynix's own guidance placed its HBM4E sample shipments in the second half of 2026, with mass production targeting 2027 — placing Samsung at least several months ahead in the qualification race.

main.title: Anthropic raises $65 billion, nears $1T valuation ahead of IPO
main.body: Anthropic closed a Series H round raising $65 billion at a $965 billion post-money valuation. Co-led by Altimeter Capital, Dragoneer, Greenoaks, and Sequoia Capital, with participation from Blackstone, Brookfield, Fidelity, and institutional investors. Samsung, SK Hynix, and Micron joined as strategic infrastructure partners. The round includes $15 billion from hyperscalers, including Amazon's previously announced $5 billion commitment. The company reported crossing a $47 billion annual run-rate revenue in May 2026 and expects a 130% revenue surge to reach first operating profit. Anthropic simultaneously released Claude Opus 4.8 featuring improved agentic capabilities and coding performance. This fundraise positions Anthropic ahead of its anticipated IPO, following OpenAI's $122 billion Series round. At $965 billion post-money, Anthropic surpasses OpenAI's $852 billion valuation from March. The round features 'a 130% revenue surge to bring it to its first operating profit.' Lead investor commitments signal strong conviction in Anthropic's constitutional AI approach and enterprise Claude adoption. Samsung, SK Hynix, and Micron participation reflects the semiconductor industry's strategic interest in AI compute infrastructure. Amazon's $5B commitment ties into its multi-year deal for AWS compute.

main.title: Jensen Huang Korea Visit: NVIDIA CEO to Meet Top Korean Conglomerates on AI, HBM Partnership
main.body: NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang will meet executives from Samsung, SK, Hyundai Motor, and LG at 'Korea Partner Night' during GTC and Computex Taipei 2026, expanding AI chip and robotics alliances. The event is held on June 1–2 in Taipei, Taiwan. A meeting between Huang and SK Chairman Choi Tae-won after the GTC opening on June 1 is drawing keen attention. Chairman Choi is expected to attend Huang's opening keynote and meet to strengthen an AI chip triangle alliance that includes TSMC. After Computex concludes, Huang plans to visit Korea around June 5 to meet again with Hyundai Motor Group Executive Chairman Euisun Chung, LG Group Chairman Kwang-mo Koo, and Naver Chairman Lee Hae-jin to expand AI alliances spanning robotics, autonomous vehicles, and manufacturing. Samsung CTO Song Jae-hyuk will host a briefing on next-generation memory technologies, seeking to capture demand for HBM4E. Samsung shipped the world's first HBM4E samples on May 29.

main.title: SoftBank €75B France Investment: Macron Signs Europe's Largest AI Infrastructure Deal
main.body: SoftBank's Masayoshi Son signed a €75 billion AI infrastructure investment deal with French President Emmanuel Macron at the Elysee Palace, the largest single AI infrastructure commitment in European history. The investment will fund data centers, AI research, and semiconductor supply chain development across France over five years. The announcement follows SoftBank's $500 billion Stargate commitment with the US government. The deal signals France's ambition to become the leading European AI hub, leveraging existing nuclear power infrastructure for low-carbon AI computing. The investment is expected to create 25,000 direct jobs and position France competitively against the UK and Germany in the race to attract AI investment post-Brexit.

main.title: Installing Out-of-the-Box Ubuntu LTS on Xsight Labs E1 64-Core Arm 800G DPU
main.body: ServeTheHome successfully installed vanilla Ubuntu LTS directly onto the Xsight Labs E1 64-core ARM DPU with 800Gbps networking capability, demonstrating vendor-neutral OS support for the next-generation DPU. The E1 features 64 ARM Neoverse-N2 cores, DDR5-5200 memory, PCIe Gen5 lanes, and dual 400G network interfaces. The installation used minimal hardware: a USB flash drive with Ubuntu 24.04 LTS arm64, a basic Realtek 1GbE NIC, and a USB-to-serial console connection at 115200 baud. They navigated the BIOS via serial connection and completed a standard Ubuntu installation without requiring custom drivers or specialized vendor builds. Geekbench 5 comparisons showed substantial improvements over NVIDIA BlueField-2 DPUs. The system subsequently upgraded successfully to Ubuntu 26.04 LTS without complications. The article notes that many other Linux-running DPUs cannot support standard vendor-neutral OS installation. The E1 was validated with SONiC-DASH Hero 800G test, validating 800Gbps of traffic with 120 million connections and 12 million connections per second with zero dropped packets. Supporting standard operating systems extends hardware utility and independence from manufacturer support lifecycles. The E1 is a direct competitor to NVIDIA BlueField-3/4 and Marvell OCTEON DPUs in the 800G segment.

main.title: Amazon Unveils Resilient Network Graphs Data Center Network — Cuts Hardware by 69%, Boosts Throughput by 33%
main.body: Amazon has made Resilient Network Graphs (RNG) the default network architecture for most AWS workloads, replacing hierarchical switching stacks that defined data center design for decades. RNG uses quasi-random graphs to create a flat network where data can take many different paths between any two points, replacing the traditional hierarchical fat-tree topology. The result includes 69% less networking hardware, 33% higher throughput, and 40% lower power consumption. Cost savings range between 9% and 45% compared to traditional fat-tree designs. The architecture relies on a custom distributed routing protocol called Spraypoint that spreads traffic efficiently across the randomized mesh, and passive optical devices called ShuffleBoxes that handle physical connections without power-hungry electronics. AWS has been quietly deploying the design in its data centers since last year and confirms it is now the default data center network for most AWS workloads. The technology is operational across data centers in Ireland, Germany, and Spain. Amazon plans approximately $200 billion in data center and AI infrastructure investment in 2026. The architecture represents the first large-scale deployment of a flat network based on random graph theory.

competitor_articles.title: NVIDIA N1X ARM Laptop Chip Confirmed for Computex: CUDA and RTX 5070 GPU Onboard
competitor_articles.body: Nvidia is preparing to unveil its first ARM-based laptop processor, the N1X, at GTC Taipei on June 1, 2026. CEO Jensen Huang will deliver a keynote, with coordinated announcements from Nvidia, Microsoft, and Arm hinting at 'a new era of PC.' The N1X pairs a 20-core ARM CPU with a Blackwell GPU containing 6,144 CUDA cores equivalent to a desktop RTX 5070. This marks the first time full CUDA support comes to Windows ARM laptops, enabling developers to run AI models locally without cloud infrastructure. Dell, Lenovo, Asus, and MSI are preparing launch models expected before the 2026 holiday season. The chip delivers roughly 31 TFLOPs of FP32 performance and 1,000 TOPS at NVFP4 precision, supporting AI inference tasks up to 200 billion parameters. Pricing estimates range from $1,000–$1,500 for consumer variants. The N1X is co-developed with MediaTek on TSMC 3nm process.

competitor_articles.title: NVIDIA Investing $6.5 Billion in Silicon Photonics for AI Data Center Networking
competitor_articles.body: NVIDIA is investing $6.5 billion in silicon photonics technology to address bandwidth bottlenecks in AI data centers. The investment targets the development of optical interconnects to replace copper-based connections between GPUs, switches, and memory in AI server clusters. Silicon photonics promises significantly higher bandwidth density and lower power consumption compared to traditional electrical interconnects. NVIDIA's investment reflects the growing recognition that as AI cluster sizes scale to millions of GPUs, conventional electrical interconnects will become the primary bottleneck. The technology is being developed for both within-rack and rack-to-rack connectivity in large-scale AI training and inference deployments.

competitor_articles.body: 엔비디아가 AI 데이터센터 네트워킹의 병목을 해소하기 위해 실리콘 포토닉스(광학 인터커넥트) 기술에 65억 달러(약 9조원)를 투자한다고 밝혔다. 기존 구리 기반 연결을 광학 연결로 대체해 GPU·스위치·메모리 간 대역폭과 전력 효율을 대폭 개선하는 게 목표다. 수백만 개의 GPU로 구성된 대규모 AI 클러스터에서는 전기 인터커넥트가 핵심 병목이 될 것으로 전망된다.

competitor_articles.title: 엔비디아 GTC 타이베이 2026: 젠슨 황, N1X·베라 루빈 발표…블랙웰·베라루빈 수주 1조 달러 전망
competitor_articles.body: 엔비디아 젠슨 황 CEO가 6월 1일 오전 11시(대만 시각) GTC 타이베이 2026 기조연설에서 Arm 노트북칩 N1X와 차세대 AI 플랫폼 베라 루빈을 공식 발표했다. 황 CEO는 블랙웰과 베라 루빈 합산 2025~2027년 누적 수주 예상액을 '최소 1조 달러'로 상향 제시했다고 밝혔다. N1X는 20코어 Arm CPU와 블랙웰 아키텍처 GPU(CUDA 6,144개)를 탑재한 SoC로, 미디어텍과 공동 개발됐다. 엔비디아 파트너스 행사에서는 삼성전자, SK하이닉스, 현대차, LG전자, 두산, 네이버 등 국내 주요 기업 경영진과의 만찬 회동이 예정됐다. 젠슨 황 CEO는 방한 일정도 가져 6월 5일께 서울을 방문할 예정이다.
competitor_articles.keep_reason: GTC 타이베이 기조연설 한국어 1차 — 베라 루빈 + N1X + Blackwell 누적 수주 1조 달러 전망, 국내 만찬 회동 디테일 추가.
